verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line listing "Predictive Segmentation" as a Mailchimp feature. That shows the product ships some form of audience segmentation, but nothing describes how segments are built or whether they update. Other items (Magento purchase data, click and open tracking) show behavioral data enters the audience, but none show it used as segment criteria. Missing for 10: documented segment building from profile attributes, tag-based segment conditions, behavioral-event segment conditions, evidence that segments update automatically as data changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes
